errors.name: BalanceInsufficient

fields.name: unallocated_tokens_left
docs: Total category allocation minus total allocations of all investors.
Used as the upper limit of allocation when adding new investors.

fields.name: total_allocated_tokens_monthly
docs: Total monthly allocations of all investors in the category.
For each month that the category claims for, this gets added to

fields.name: tokens_ready_for_claim
docs: The number of tokens that must stay in the category,
because they are currently available for investors to claim.
Used as the upper limit for manual category withdrawal.
